name: pi-zentui
description: A Starship-inspired statusline and Opencode-style TUI for Pi.

scripts.test:fixed-editor: vitest run --maxWorkers=1 test/fixed-editor-editor-layout.test.ts test/fixed-editor-layout.test.ts test/fixed-editor.test.ts test/editor-viewport-indicators.test.ts test/minimalist-editor.test.ts test/session-lifecycle.test.ts test/fixed-editor-terminal-state.test.ts test/fixed-editor-pty.test.ts && vitest run --maxWorkers=1 test/extension-compliance.test.ts -t 'fixed editor|fixed-editor|fixed layout|fixed-layout'
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run verify && npm run pack:check
